# S22 — Today view

A non-technical member's default screen: tonight's dinner, mark it made, and a link to the list (P1, P3, U2).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:** web

**Not in this slice:** notifications; pantry nudges.

## Why

This is the screen everyday users actually use. It must be readable at a glance and need one tap at most.

## Owner input

1. What else, if anything, belongs on it: tomorrow's dinner? A "defrost tonight" hint (needs a recipe flag)?
2. Label wording ("Made it" / "Skip tonight")?
